## Triage: first-touch audit → `domain:spec` · **p1** confirmed · 2026-11-15T14:23Z

⛔ Not a claim. Requested by domain:spec#2 (mailbox comment 6895909249).

Q1 of #33689 was ruled B on 2026-11-15 at 11:10:57Z. Under that ruling, the AI-door confirmation rule binds every door that starts a declared-gated action (`ai.requiresConfirmation: true`), the in-app assistant included. The in-app door may decide only as the person the call ran as, from a signed-in session, with every gate re-checked. Until the contract says so, the in-app door is a side path around a declared confirmation gate. That is a permission boundary (#32997 rule 4), so **p1** stands. The change is contract text plus pinned tests in `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`; `IAIService`'s pending-action members stay.
